rules.title: Wildcard IAM policies are prohibited
rules.summary: Policies must not grant Action:* on Resource:*.
rules.description: Wildcard grants defeat least privilege and make audit trails meaningless: any compromise inherits full account authority.
rules.remediation: Scope actions and resources to the specific service and ARN required.

rules.title: Privileged roles must require MFA
rules.summary: Admin and operator roles must enforce multi-factor authentication.
rules.description: Single-factor credentials on privileged roles are the most common path to unauthorized change in shared infrastructure.
rules.remediation: Attach an MFA condition to the role trust policy.

checks.condition: access.mfa is true when access.privilege is 'admin' or 'operator'
